decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - This permission shall be for a limited period of the duration of the construction of the development permitted under planning permission 00609/BH/P2.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 3 - The car park and access shall be maintained to the satisfaction of the Planning Authority. Any damage shall be repaired to ensure the pedestrian area remains accessible.
description: Variation of condition 39 of planning permission 00609/BH/P2 to allow for temporary car parking arrangements for 66 spaces in the piazza and 9-12 High Street and 1-6 Wilton Walk.
